hard_case: Every expectation that sees the body uses always() or no .with(..), so the message text is never checked even though the mock is called.

mutants.replacement: format!("{}, your book is {} days overdue", user, overdue_days)
mutants.mutated_line: let body = format!("{}, your book is {} days overdue", user, overdue_days);
mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: the body says "overdue" instead of "late"

mutants.replacement: format!("{}, your book is {} days late", user, overdue_days + 1)
mutants.mutated_line: let body = format!("{}, your book is {} days late", user, overdue_days + 1);
mutants.equivalence_review: not equivalent: the body reports 46 days instead of 45

reasoning: sends_some_body expects one send with any arguments and reminds_only_after_the_grace_period matches the body with always(), so changing the wording or the day count goes undetected.
